verdict.rationale: v0's pricing docs describe the plans (Premium at $20/month with higher limits), credit top-ups on Premium, Plus and Business, and a team shared credit pool. The API docs note that starting from existing files uses no tokens. A community user reports usage-based costs adding up quickly, which points to limited cost transparency but doesn't contradict the docs. Missing for 10: per-action credit/token consumption breakdown, concrete credit allotments per plan, in-product usage visibility, independent corroboration that costs are understandable.

support.subject: As a founder, I can understand what credits or tokens each action consumes and what my plan includes

citations.quote: Premium: $20/month. For higher limits and power users.
You can buy more credits any time (Premium, Plus, and Business plans).
Shared Credit Pool credits are shared among all team members
Start with existing files (fast, no tokens)
